## Contract review

Served-tier: `TIER_DEFAULT`
Head-sha: `ad57b709e643fec2304f17ecb21efea8cf2bee5d`
Local-runs: none

Read: card #37454 (body, claim 7190624039, reports 7192209474 and 7193948346, amendment 7192233242), the final-head comment 7194013036, the P1-3 row of epic #37424's phase table (7184108099), ADR-0084 § 概览 Overview on main, the PR body, and the net diff `origin/main...ad57b709` (22 files, +1758/−434). Check-runs on the head: 47 success, 15 skipped, 0 failed or pending.

### ① Derived judgments

**Acceptance, line by line.**
- 概览 is the first menu row, above the groups and under no group. It carries the pending count as a badge only while the count is above zero, and a click on the badge opens `?tab=pending`. `~org` and `~all` draw no row. Met (`StudioMenu.tsx` `renderOverview`, `studioMenuOverviewEntry`).
- The header reuses `StudioItemHeader`. It shows the name, 系统自带 (with a lock) or 可写, 使用中 or 已停用, the description, and the ⋯ menu with its six rows unchanged. Disable, enable and delete stay in Setup (Q1 = B). Met. A row with no boolean `enabled` draws no chip, so nothing is guessed.
- The Info tab is read-only: name, description, source, version and app. The id, namespace and type are folded under 技术信息. Met.
- The Pending tab is `DraftChangesPanel` drawn in place. It gets `doPublish`, or `undefined` when `publishReadOnly`, plus `draftScope` (the pair, per ADR-0146 D3), `renderPublishRefusal`, `customizationOf` and `publishing`, the same props the top-bar sheet gets. The two differ only in `posture` (the default `review`) and `include` (used only when no package is open), and neither changes the publish request. Met.
- "Publishing behaves exactly as from the top bar": `publishCount-11807` now runs every case through both doors with `describe.each`, and no expectation was loosened. Met.
- Read-only posture: there is a lock chip, the source line says the package is read-only, and `onPublish` is undefined on both doors (tested). Met.
- The copy says AI drafts (`engine.studio.overview.pendingNote`). Met.
- There is no `package` metadata type. The page reads the package REST list. The top-bar Publish stays until #37456. Met.
- The epic's P1-3 row ("概览 first entry, Info + Pending tabs, ⋯ moved") is met in full. The 导出 button and the 发布历史 tab are phase 2 under the governing text, and the PR rightly leaves them out.

**Surface.**
- Every path is inside the claim: `studio-design/**`, `preview/DraftChangesPanel.tsx`, the studio i18n namespace files and one changeset.
- `StudioMenu.tsx` gains only the 概览 row: imports, the context read, `renderOverview`, its call, and the row joining the no-matches condition. That is within amendment 7192233242.
- `studio-tokens.ts`, `studioAccent.ts`, `studioTitleRow.tsx` and `PageShell.tsx` are untouched.
- `DraftChangesPanel` keeps its default behaviour. Its body is moved into a shared fragment, and its new props are optional.

**New address and menu-model entries.**
- The `overview` family has a builder that the address test pins, and the table lists it.
- Deep links: `/studio/PACKAGE/overview?tab=pending` opens Pending (tested). An unknown `?tab=` value falls back to Info (tested).
- Back and forward: switching tabs replaces the history entry, as `flowDesignerTabs` and `objectDesignerTabs` do. The badge pushes a new entry.
- An unknown or uninstalled package hits the existing `pkgMissing` not-found branch, which comes before the overview branch. `~org/overview` redirects to the org scope, and `~all` never reaches the branch. Package-less scopes draw no row and no page. All of this is correct, but none of it is tested on this address (S2).

**States.**
- Loading: a spinner.
- Error: `loadFailed` with the envelope's message in `role=alert`, so a 403 shows its sentence.
- Empty: 未填写, and the app row is dropped when the package has no app.
- Permission refused: no ⋯ without `manage_metadata` (tested), and the header is still drawn.
- Pending inherits the panel's own empty, loading and error states.

**Accept sets and public surface.**
- No server route, spec or protocol file changes.
- `ListedPackageManifest` gains the optional fields `enabled` and `source`, read from the row as served.
- `DraftChangesPanel` gains the optional props `embedded` and `reloadKey`.
- `StudioBackToApp` loses its `menu` prop. `StudioBackToApp` is not exported from the app-shell index, and `StudioDesignSurface` was its only consumer.
- All of these sit in `@object-ui/app-shell`, which is `private: true`: it is versioned but not published to npm.
- `@object-ui/i18n` is published. It gains 22 studio catalogue keys, purely additive. They change no accept set.
- Each of these changes is judged right.

**i18n.** en and zh add the same 22 keys. Every key is used, and the reused keys `engine.packages.source.*` and `engine.studio.pkg.readonlyHint` exist in both files. No new strings are hard-coded. See N2 and N3 for wording and a11y.

**Tests.**
- The new overview tests run the real surface, and the new menu tests run the real provider, sidebar and router. They include real controls: `~org` and `~all` draw no row, a ledger of 0 or null draws no badge, a writable chip is kept beside 已停用, no ⋯ without `manage_metadata`, the sheet still dismisses toasts, and an unmoved `reloadKey` reads nothing more.
- The re-pointed tests (`11807`, `37139`, `StudioMenu.test`) are not weakened.
- The PR body reports ablation legs A1–A6 and B1–B3, each going red.

**Findings.**
- S1 (should-fix) — `STUDIO_OVERVIEW_TAB_PARAM = 'tab'` is minted as a new literal in `studioAddress.ts`. The ui AGENTS rule #8 that the PR body cites says `?tab=` constants live in `urlParams.ts`, and `RECORD_DETAIL_TAB_PARAM` already holds `'tab'`; `ITEM_TOOL_TAB_PARAM` aliases it. The new `STUDIO_QUERY_PARAMS` row also says `tab` is "Read on the overview only", but Studio's item pages already read `?tab=` through `ITEM_TOOL_TAB_PARAM` on metadata addresses. Fix: alias the existing constant, and reword the row so it covers both readers.
- S2 (should-fix) — Several paths on the new address have no test:
  - the overview's own failure state (`studio-overview-load-failed`) and its loading state;
  - an unknown package at `/studio/PACKAGE/overview` landing on not-found;
  - `~org/overview` redirecting.
  The code is right today, but nothing pins the branch order that keeps a missing package off the overview. One failing-list case and one unknown-id case would close the gap.
- N1 (nit) — Push-down. The Info tab reads the whole `GET /api/v1/packages` list and picks one row on the client (`rows.get(packageId)`), although `GET /packages/:id` serves the same projection. The page states a reason: it shares the request the surface already sends. That holds on a cold mount. Entering 概览 from another Studio page, and each `refreshKey` move, still sends a full-list read. The list is the package registry and no SQL is involved, so this is not a Prime Directive 5 breach. A single-row read is the narrower choice.
- N2 (nit) — The loading row is a `p` holding only an `aria-hidden` spinner, so assistive tech gets nothing while the read is in flight. It needs a `role=status` with sr-only text.
- N3 (nit) — In English, `engine.studio.menu.overviewPending` reads "1 changes wait for a publish" at a count of 1. The badge's aria-label and the tab title both use this key.
- N4 (nit) — In `StudioPackageMenu-37139`, the "no ⋯ without a current package" checks on `~org` and `~all` now pass vacuously. The menu is drawn only on the overview, which those scopes never reach, so the checks can no longer fail on the gate they name.

### ② Semver level

- The changeset bumps `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` by patch.
- `Metadata-protocol: none` is right: nothing a metadata author can write changes. Under AGENTS.md checklist step 3, `none` takes patch, so the level is right.
- Published packages: `@object-ui/i18n` only. `@object-ui/app-shell` is private, versioned under `privatePackages`, and not published to npm.
- `Clause-②: no` is right. No published accept set or public surface widens: the i18n keys are additive catalogue entries, and every API change is in the private app-shell.
- No narrowing arm is owed. The changeset body carries both declaration lines, and they match the PR body.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Round-1 `open_questions` (how the 概览 row lands, given `StudioMenu.tsx` was read-only): answered by amendment 7192233242 (option A). The diff stays within it. The PR is back to `Fixes #37454`.
- Round-2 `open_questions`: none.
- `out_of_scope_findings` (the mockup's pair-aware source sentence; 导出 and 发布历史): agreed, not owed here. 导出 and 发布历史 are phase 2 in ADR-0084. The source sentence is copy that a later pass can take up.
- Deviations: the broad suite ran on 618c0cf1, and ad57b709 only swaps one icon import. CI on ad57b709 is green, so nothing is outstanding.
- SQL push-down: no new id materialisation and no in-app join over SQL-backed data. The one client-side filter is N1, and the page gives its reason.

It covers the seat's REWORK 7194226440 (S1, S2 and N3 owed; N2 optional; N1 and N4 accepted), the dev's report 7196412422, the area's delta note 7196450289, `git diff ad57b709..29bb079f` (two commits, 14 files, +218/−51, with no merge of main) and the net diff against `origin/main` (23 files, +1931/−440).

Check-runs on the new head: 46 success, 15 skipped and 1 in progress. The one in progress is a second `Check Changeset` run that the PR-body edit started at 15:35Z. The first `Check Changeset` run on this head finished with success at 15:12Z. Nothing has failed.

### ① Derived judgments

**Surface.** Every new or changed path is under `studio-design/**` or the studio i18n namespace files, and the changeset line is reworded.
- The new module `studioOverviewAddress.ts` is inside the claimed glob.
- `StudioMenu.tsx` changes only in the 概览 badge's label, so it stays inside amendment 7192233242.
- The read-only files are still untouched.

**Prior findings.**
- **S1: closed.**
  - `STUDIO_OVERVIEW_TAB_PARAM` is deleted. The page, the builder and the address table now use `RECORD_DETAIL_TAB_PARAM` from `urlParams.ts`, the key `ITEM_TOOL_TAB_PARAM` aliases.
  - The `STUDIO_QUERY_PARAMS` row now names both readers: an item page's tab, and `pending` on the overview.
  - I checked the reason given for the move: `urlParams.ts` imports `STUDIO_RETURN_PARAM` from `studioAddress.ts`, so the builder could not stay in `studioAddress.ts` without a cycle. The new module imports both and nothing imports it back.
  - The URL is unchanged: `studioPath` accepts a `URLSearchParams` query, and the existing builder test still expects `/studio/crm/overview?tab=pending`.
  - `studioAddress.test` now also pins that the builder writes the reserved key.
- **S2: closed.** A new describe, "the overview's branch order", adds these pins:
  - a failed row read gives `role=alert` in place of the fields, and the header stays;
  - a read still on the wire gives a `role=status` loading row with neither a failure nor fields; as a control, the fields appear once the read answers;
  - `/studio/com.nowhere.pkg/overview` lands on not-found, with no overview and no menu;
  - `~org/overview` redirects to `studioOrgScopePath()`. This is read twice, once through the pillar redirect and once on the bare surface.

  The dev reports ablations C1–C5, all red except C4b. C4b is a stated green control. The pillar door alone cannot be singled out because the surface's own guard sits behind it, and C4c shows that turning off both doors goes red. That reasoning holds.
- **N1: open, accepted by the seat.** Nothing changed: the page still picks one row out of the full `GET /packages` list.
- **N2: closed.** The loading row is `role=status` with sr-only `engine.studio.overview.loading`, in both en and zh. The loading test pins it.
- **N3: open, narrowed.** The menu badge now picks `engine.studio.menu.overviewPendingOne` at a count of 1. That follows the catalogue's existing `…One` pattern (for example `publishedAllCountOne`), and the en and zh forms are pinned. But my N3 named two places, and the Pending tab's count title in `StudioPackageOverviewPage.tsx` still calls `tFormat('engine.studio.menu.overviewPending', …)` without the singular. With one draft, its hover title still reads "1 changes wait for a publish". It stays a nit: the tab's count is visible text, and the title is only a tooltip. See N5.
- **N4: closed.** The `~org` and `~all` no-⋯ checks in `StudioPackageMenu-37139` now ask at `/overview` and also assert that no overview is drawn. A branch reorder that drew the overview there would now fail them.

**i18n.** en and zh each gain the same two keys, `menu.overviewPendingOne` and `overview.loading`, so both files hold 24 matching new keys in all. The zh singular reads the same as the plural, which is right for Chinese. No new strings are hard-coded.

Choosing `engine.studio.menu.overviewPendingOne` at a count of 1, as `StudioMenu.tsx` now does, would finish N3. This is the open remainder of N3, given its own id. It does not affect correctness.

### ⛔ merge queue 构建失败 — 先分诊，再决定要不要重排

队列构建 [45851357602](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/45851357602) 红了。队列跑的是**全量**套件（PR 侧 CI 只跑 affected 子集），
所以失败的测试可能在本 PR 没碰过的包里 —— 那不是重排能修的。每次盲目重排都会让排在后面的所有 PR 重建一轮。

**分类：`failure`** —— 按下面的日志分诊。

**失败的 job（日志抽取，best effort）：**

- **[Test UI (13/16)](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/45851357602/job/140019633549)** — 失败步骤: Run the ui tests (shard 13/16)

  ```
  × a name save keeps the id and the email, takes the new name, and remounts nothing 13ms
  FAIL   dom  packages/auth/src/__tests__/AuthProvider.test.tsx > updateUser keeps the signed-in identity (objectstack#36972) > a name save keeps the id and the email, takes the new name, and remounts n
    ↳ 失败原因: AssertionError: expected 2 to be 1 // Object.is equality
  ```

> `↳ 失败原因` 是判读的关键：**超时**（`Test timed out in …` / `Hook timed out in …`）多半是负载/时序，不是本 PR 的回归；
> **断言**（`AssertionError: …`）才指向真实的行为改变。两者的 `FAIL` 行长得一模一样，只有这一行能区分。
>
> ⚠️ **断言这一侧有一类例外，判据是断言在测什么，不是它是不是 `AssertionError`。** 断言的对象是**产品行为**（一个值、一个形状、一次拒收）⇒ 照上面读：真实的行为改变，去查，⛔ 不要重排掉；
> 断言的对象是**这次实验自身的有效性前提**（跑完的耗时、负载下的先后、任何只在时间预算内才成立的条件）⇒ 它跟**超时**是同一类，同样对负载敏感，重排一次是合法的判别手段。
> 识别是机械的：断言的消息或它比较的值本身点名了一段**时长、一个时间戳、一个耗时计数**。实测过的一对 —— `AssertionError: SecurityPlugin.init() ran: expected false to be true` 测的是产品行为（真回归）；
> `AssertionError: this run took over a second, so second-precision stamps could have differed too: expected 1006 to be less than 1000` 测的是实验前提：它守护的那条不变式当时是绿的，同一个 head 原样重排一次即成功。
